title: Getting Less Wrong Without Becoming Certain
summary: Reading Yudkowsky's Sequences alongside Hume, with Bayesian updating, human utility functions, model uncertainty and the premises behind Roko's basilisk.

title: Text to Trajectory
summary: How grounding, task programs, motion planning and learned robot policies turn language into movement, with a focused evaluation proposed for Visual Components.

title: ChargeWise Fits the Fleet to the Grid
summary: Building ChargeWise AI with physical charging constraints, independent schedule checks, the original hosted application, Nemotron tools, and a forecasting follow-up.

title: When Do AI Outputs Tip?
summary: One attention head tested across sixteen held-out Qwen2.5-0.5B prompts, a mathematical response clock, and cache edits that hold current answers fixed.

title: Gold Medals Don't Stack Batteries: Building Training Grounds for AI Agents
summary: From programming medals to battery stacking: verifiable environments, six 2026 agent and robotics projects, and practical tests for learning rewards, recovery, and resets.

title: Price Wars: East vs. West Battery Production and the SynBatt Response
summary: One animated timeline of manufacturers and factory plans. Grouped company cases connect funding, ramp-up, and customer demand, alongside twenty price-gap mechanisms and the SynBatt response.

title: How to (Not) Reinvent the Wheel With Jeff
summary: Jev, Jeff, and typed decisions: shared representations, task-specific heads, calibrated probabilities, and a concrete policy for when a manufacturing model acts or requests review.

title: DisCo and the Case for Reusable Agent Skills
summary: DisCo distills repositories and papers into reusable operating skills. Scope, ground, construct, and verify: a practical route from research knowledge to repeatable workflows.

title: Reading ConvMem: Long-Context Reasoning as a Summary Tree
summary: ConvMem reads a long document as a tree of question-conditioned summaries instead of a chain of memory updates, which cuts the path from a fact to the answer from linear to logarithmic. Notes on the method, results and cost, and seven ideas for a path shorter than logarithmic.

title: I Checked 2,294 arXiv Equations for Upside-Down Fractions
summary: An exploratory LLM-assisted audit flags 112 of 2,294 display rows, including one strict fraction reversal. Reviewer accuracy and clipboard causation remain unmeasured.

title: I Ran a Game-Theory RL-Menu Agent in GLEE for 48 Hours (No LLM)
summary: Debugging a no-LLM GLEE agent through reward normalisation, seat-matched comparisons and bargaining timing, with controlled results separated from live rankings.

title: Finding a Fair Evaluation Under Changing Representations
summary: A proposed matched-input task for testing representation adaptation, with a frozen-feature ceiling, separate retention audits and resource-matched baselines.

title: The Student Becomes the Teacher
summary: Self-distillation transfers a model’s own supervision. Majority pseudo-labels can correct minority errors or reinforce systematic mistakes; flatness alone guarantees neither generalisation nor retention.

title: From Simulating Speech to Optimizing Reasoning
summary: What latent steering, multiplex tokens and compressed plans establish about reasoning, with measured hint acknowledgement and task-specific limits.

title: The Race to O(n)
summary: Sparse patterns, DSA indexing, recurrent memory and conditional complexity bounds, with vendor claims separated from independent architectural evidence.

title: Lithium Dendrites Are Batteries' Dandelions
summary: A lithium-and-sodium dendrite model linking defect geometry, fracture and electronic leakage, with an explicit sodium example and unresolved current-scale mismatch.

title: AI's Bottleneck Is Physical
summary: Sensing, data lineage, latency and safe interventions constrain industrial AI. A bottleneck illustration and deployment examples, rather than a fitted scaling law.

title: Reading CausalPFN: Causal Effects as In-Context Prediction
summary: A NeurIPS 2025 paper trains one transformer on simulated, identifiable causal worlds; new observational data goes in as context, treatment-effect posteriors come out. What holds it up, and where it breaks.

title: The Geometry of Forgetting in Continual Learning
summary: An exact fixed-feature squared-loss calculation at stationarity, its second-order extension, and frozen-backbone IGFA results on Rotated-Digits.

title: Modelling the Electrode Calendering U-Shape
summary: A process-dependent contact closure fits 27 graphite and NMC calendering states. Reorientation is a plausible graphite mechanism that thermal data alone cannot isolate.
